natural_language.good: Sounds like a person talking to this shopper; plain familiar words, easy first read, approximately below grade 10.
natural_language.bad: Jargon, brochure voice, tangled sentences, childish or robotic simplification.

avatar_fit.good: Speaks to the specific brief and plausible concern without invented customer research.
avatar_fit.bad: Generic parent copy or a scenario inconsistent with the brief.

credible_bridge.good: Makes a realistic unwanted situation, desired improvement and supported product mechanism connect naturally, even implicitly.
credible_bridge.bad: Grand transformation, empty reassurance, missing mechanism, forced Before/After labels or unsupported outcome.

benefit.good: Gives a practical reason this feature matters to this person.
benefit.bad: Inventory dump or vague aspiration without useful gain.

visual_specificity.good: A concrete object or action makes the message easy to picture.

crispness.good: Every sentence earns its place, clear headline and natural CTA.
crispness.bad: Padding, repeated disclaimers or stock marketing language.

distinctiveness.bad: Repeated idea with different opening synonyms.

scale: 0-5; 0 unusable, 1 major rewrite, 2 substantial edits, 3 usable with noticeable edits, 4 light edits, 5 exceptional.
limits: AI editorial proxies; no measured reading grade, human preference or advertising performance. New rubric: old scores are not directly comparable.
stop: One frozen revision; no rerolls to obtain a winning score.
